elements.element: HDI warrants that the Services will be performed in a workmanlike manner.
elements.evidence: Section 9(c)(1) expressly warrants that the Services will be performed in a “workmanlike manner.”

elements.element: Replacement is available as a remedy for breach of the performance or conformance warranties.
elements.evidence: The final sentence identifies “replacement” as a Company remedy for breach involving non-conforming Services, deliverables, or software.

elements.element: HDI warrants that the Services will be performed in a professional manner.
elements.evidence: Section 9(c)(1) expressly includes a professional-manner warranty.

elements.evidence: Section 9(c)(1) expressly includes a workmanlike-manner warranty.

elements.element: The professional-and-workmanlike Services warranty remains effective for at least 30 days from an ascertainable service-related commencement point.
elements.evidence: Although the clause nominally provides a longer 90-day period, it does not identify when that period begins, so it does not establish an enforceable 30-day minimum from a defined trigger.

elements.element: Each deliverable conforms to its documentation.
elements.evidence: Section 9(c)(2) expressly warrants conformity of each deliverable to its documentation.

elements.element: The deliverable conformance warranty lasts at least 90 days following delivery.
elements.evidence: The stated 12-month period following delivery exceeds the 90-day fallback period.

elements.element: All software conforms to its documentation.
elements.evidence: Section 9(c)(2) expressly warrants conformity of all software to its documentation.

elements.element: The software conformance warranty lasts at least 90 days following delivery.
elements.evidence: The stated 12-month software warranty following delivery exceeds the 90-day fallback period.

elements.element: Repair is available as a remedy for breach of the performance or conformance warranties.
elements.evidence: The final sentence expressly provides repair as a remedy.

elements.element: Replacement is available as a remedy for breach of the performance or conformance warranties.
elements.evidence: The final sentence expressly provides replacement as a remedy.

elements.element: Refund of the fees paid for the non-conforming Services, deliverable, or software is available as a remedy.
elements.evidence: The final sentence expressly provides a refund of fees paid for the affected Services, deliverable, or software.

result.reason: The redline substantively supplies the requested quality, conformity, legal-compliance, malicious-code, and remedy protections and leaves the original warranties intact. However, the Services warranty merely says “for a period of 90 days” without identifying when that period starts. That omitted trigger prevents the Services warranty from clearly satisfying either the 90-day preferred duration or the 30-day fallback duration. A minimal cure would specify that the applicable period begins upon completion or performance of the relevant Services.
